name: Keg of Shindigger Stout
summary: In Dun Garok, Shindigger Stout fills the dwarves’ kegs and draws interest from Tarren Mill. The Royal Apothecary Society wants the ale for a purpose far darker than drink.

sections.title: A Dwarven Favorite
sections.body: Dwarves of Ironforge hold Dun Garok in the southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. Within its barracks and mess halls, defenders share Shindigger Stout through the cold and the siege against their regional enemies. The brew is a staple of the garrison’s daily life.

sections.title: Apothecary Lydon's Poison Vessel
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks an intact keg of Shindigger Stout for the Forsaken’s Elixir of Agony. He rejects testing the formula on beasts and plans to spike the ale for captured human farmers held in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What is Shindigger Stout used for?
aliases: what does lydon do with the keg
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill wants Shindigger Stout for the Elixir of Agony. He plans to lace the ale with the poison and test it on humanoid subjects.

faq.q: Where can a Keg of Shindigger Stout be found?
faq.answer: Kegs of Shindigger Stout are kept in Dun Garok, in the southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. The dwarves store them in the fortress’s mess halls and lower barracks.
The dwarves of Dun Garok brew and keep Shindigger Stout. They hold a fortified garrison in Hillsbrad Foothills for Ironforge.

faq.q: Why doesn't Apothecary Lydon brew his own alcohol for the test?
faq.answer: Lydon asks for a keg kept at Dun Garok to use in his experiment. The account gives no reason beyond his need for the ale and says nothing about him brewing alcohol himself.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can use alcohol to mask the scent and taste of deadly concoctions made for Lady Sylvanas.
As Horde, you can strike at Dun Garok, an Alliance military foothold in the southeastern hills of Hillsbrad Foothills.
